tone_statements.quote: Bahasa Gebe menarik untuk dikaji karena memiliki keunikan dalam hal struktur bahasa. Dalam hal fonologi, khususnya mengenai bunyi suprasegmental terdapat nada-nada panjang pendek, naik turun tetapi sifatnya tidak membedakan makna.
tone_statements.translation: The Gebe language is interesting to study because it has unique features of linguistic structure. As regards phonology, in particular the suprasegmental sounds, there are long and short, rising and falling pitches, but by their nature they do not distinguish meaning.

tone.quote: Bahasa Gebe menarik untuk dikaji karena memiliki keunikan dalam hal struktur bahasa. Dalam hal fonologi, khususnya mengenai bunyi suprasegmental terdapat nada-nada panjang pendek, naik turun tetapi sifatnya tidak membedakan makna.
tone.translation: The Gebe language is interesting to study because it has unique features of linguistic structure. As regards phonology, in particular the suprasegmental sounds, there are long and short, rising and falling pitches, but by their nature they do not distinguish meaning.
tone.says: Passing introductory remark (not a phonological analysis): Gebe has suprasegmental length and rising/falling pitch, but these are not meaning-distinguishing, i.e. no lexical tone is claimed. No data or minimal pairs given; the article is about person markers.
